Bank of Baroda Responds to $15 Billion Lawsuit Claim

Bank of Baroda has responded to reports of a $15 billion lawsuit filed by Bavaguthu Raghuram Shetty in the Bombay High Court. The bank stated that it has not yet received any court papers or legal notice regarding the suit. Bank of Baroda affirmed that it will "firmly defend" its interests in court. The bank's shares saw a decline amid the clarification on the lawsuit.
